alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: Highest ALT or AST
alt_ast_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Abnormal liver enzymes in HCC may reflect cirrhosis, progression, obstruction, infection or immune toxicity. A lab result alone does not diagnose immune hepatitis; establish cause and the matching baseline.

creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.label: Serum creatinine relative to baseline or ULN
creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.assessment_guidance: A creatinine rise requires cause assessment (including dehydration, obstruction, HCC-related kidney disease, bevacizumab injury and immune nephritis). This ratio alone does not establish immune causation.

notes: Both agents have minimal emetogenic potential; no routine premedication or routine preventive antiemetic is specified. Use symptom-directed/local policy.
Retain immunotherapy alert card and 24-hour contact plan during and after treatment.
Screen and manage oesophageal varices before bevacizumab; review BP and urine protein before each cycle.
Atezolizumab and bevacizumab require separate interruption/discontinuation decisions; no source dose reductions.

Atezolizumab contraception for 5 months and bevacizumab for 6 months after treatment; combined counselling uses the longer relevant interval. Bevacizumab breastfeeding restriction continues for at least 6 months after the last dose.
